title: Column & Row Span
definition: Utilities for controlling how many columns or rows a single grid item should stretch across.
simpleExplanation: If you have a 3-column grid, but you want a massive 'Featured Image' to stretch all the way across the top, you use `col-span-3`. It tells that specific item to merge 3 cells together into one giant cell.
realWorldExample: A newspaper layout where the main headline article spans 2 columns, while the minor articles next to it only span 1 column.

basic: If a parent is `grid-cols-4`, what class makes a child take up half the grid?

answers.question: col-span-full?
answers.answer: It forces the item to stretch across ALL available columns in the grid, regardless of whether it is a 3-column grid or a 12-column grid.
